claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: SB-225002 is a selective non-peptide CXCR2 antagonist with no reported direct cytotoxicity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, with any killing likely reflecting weak non-specific effects rather than a shared mechanism class.
